name: UMBRELLA_ST_CLOSED
meaning: closed (anim 7 on the ground, anim 6 held)

name: UMBRELLA_ST_OPENING_GROUND
meaning: msg 0x15 with arg != 3: anim 2; at anim end -> OPEN, anim 3

name: UMBRELLA_ST_OPENING_AIR
meaning: msg 0x15 with arg 3 (Wolf 0x81): anim 0; at anim end -> OPEN, anim 5

name: UMBRELLA_ST_OPEN
meaning: open; the anim follows the Wolf state through msg 0x10

name: UMBRELLA_ST_CLOSING
meaning: msg 0x16: anim 1 (air) or 4 (ground); at anim end -> CLOSED, anim 6
